items.text: Deebo Samuel out for remainder of game (hamstring). Rapoport confirms ruled out.
items.implication: Immediate sit remaining; monitor severity for ROS. Beneficiaries in WAS offense.
items.opportunity: Snap/target shift to other WAS WRs/TEs with Daniels.

items.text: Cardinals trade Marvin Harrison Jr. + 2027 7th to Texans for 2027 2nd + 6th. MHJ inactive today pre-trade; reunites with Stroud.
items.implication: MHJ fresh start in HOU with Collins/Dell/Boutte; ARI WR room elevates others immediately and ROS.
items.opportunity: ARI: Michael Wilson etc. role expansion; HOU: long-term WR depth, short-term inactive.

items.text: Terry McLaurin will play; Schefter lists among actives. Returning from hamstring, with Diggs out and Daniels back.
items.implication: Start McLaurin as WR2/3 in favorable spot with Daniels return.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share with Diggs out; possible limited snaps early.

items.text: Justin Jefferson active for Vikings; Jordan Addison inactive. Jefferson expected to play through ankle injury vs NO.
items.why: Official actives; Rapoport and ETR aligned on Jefferson in, Addison out.
items.implication: Jefferson WR1 usage restored; Addison sit. Potential target bump for Jefferson.
items.opportunity: Jefferson primary target; Addison absence opens slots but Jefferson volume rises.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty is a go after pregame workout; previously hopeful GTD with plantar fasciitis/ankle. ETR confirms will play.
items.why: Rapoport sources + ETR FINAL UPDATE; elevated backup just in case earlier.
items.implication: Start Jeanty as RB1/2 but monitor workload limits from foot/ankle.
items.opportunity: Lead back carries/routes if healthy enough; reverse any handcuff starts.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase will play in Week 5 after clearing concussion concerns; Tee Higgins also will play through adductor/neck issues. Both Bengals WRs active vs MIA.
items.why: ETR final updates and Schefter corroboration after full practices.
items.implication: Full WR1/WR2 stack available for CIN offense; start both confidently.
items.opportunity: Normal routes/targets expected; no major snap dock reported.

items.text: Zay Flowers officially active for Ravens (vs ATL).
items.implication: Start Flowers despite backup QB situation.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets with Lamar out.

items.text: Jaylen Warren workhorse praise with Rico Dowdle out; passes advanced stats/eye test, Austin Ekeler-esque. Coaches previously refused full load.
items.why: Dowdle not expected/out; Levitan data + eye test.
items.implication: Strong start Warren as RB2/flex; high upside carries/targets.
items.opportunity: Full backfield snaps, routes, goal-line with Dowdle absence.

items.text: George Kittle active despite illness; expected to play vs SEA.
items.why: Official active confirmation after expected report.
items.implication: Start Kittle as TE1; no major dock anticipated.

items.text: Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (foot). Earlier ETR not expected.
items.why: Schefter report; prior ETR not expected to play.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; treat as non-factor. Avoid or pivot off him.
items.opportunity: Targets/snaps shift to other Chargers WRs like Tre Harris if available.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out (groin). Earlier questionable.
items.implication: HOU RB committee shift; start handcuff or other backs.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining HOU RBs.

items.text: Caleb Williams officially inactive (hamstring); chance to play next week. ETR had not expected.
items.implication: Bears backup QB; fade CHI pass catchers somewhat or adjust projections.
items.opportunity: Backup QB opportunity; CHI WR/TE volume may drop or change style.

items.text: Rico Dowdle not expected to play; pairs with Levitan Warren workhorse upgrade.
items.implication: Clear path for Warren; sit Dowdle.

items.text: Marvin Harrison not expected to play (pre-trade inactive); elevates ARI pass catchers.
items.why: ETR summary; confirmed inactive then traded.
items.implication: Sit MHJ; pivot to Wilson/McBride etc.
items.opportunity: ARI WR/TE target share increase short-term.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume and red zone vs struggling secondary. Aligns with MHJ non-factor/trade.
items.why: Love/Hate volume/matchup; MHJ inactive/trade elevates further.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.why: Berry observation of widespread adds post-performance/role.
items.implication: Priority waiver add for GB RB depth/handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: Potential expanded role if Jacobs limited or opportunity arises.

items.text: Messiest injury week remembered; docks on players playing through, ton of GTDs, Bengals WRs delayed info. Projections updated live.
items.why: Levitan overview amid multiple GTDs and late updates.
items.implication: Monitor projections closely; high volatility slate.

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; high volume including red zone vs weak defense.
items.why: Target hog + matchup gift in Love/Hate.
